messages:
Hana: Quick lunchtime idea  12:30 crag sprint up the west stair path + optional protein-cookie wager? Fastest up gets the cookie. Low pressure, zero ego. :climbing: :cookie:
Marco: Im in if the cookie is gluten-free. Also how many flights is the west path? :eyes:
Hana: About 8 steep flights, short jog to the crag at the top. If youre unsure, you can walk one direction and run the other. :slightly_smiling_face:
Leah: Ill do a power-walk version. Meeting a client at 1 so need to avoid the full sprint. :sweat_smile:
Sam: Count me tentative. Im still nursing a tweaky calf. I can cheer and be official bell-ringer. :bell:
Hana: @here React with :runner: if youre sprinting / :walking: for power-walk / :raised_hand: for cheer/official. Ill tally in 10.
Facilities-bot: Event created: "Crag sprint + protein-cookie bet" @12:30 (30m). Stair access note: west stair temporarily has maintenance cones near step 4; use caution.
Marco: Good shout about cones. Ill aim for cautious sprint. Also bringing a tiny container of protein cookies (two flavors)  winner picks their flavor. :muscle:
Leah: If you win, you must pose for the obligatory triumphant-step photo for #random. No ducking. :camera_with_flash:
Sam: Official rules: if winner crosses and crumbs the cookie into a teammates laptop, immediate rematch + coffee for the victim. :coffee:
Hana: Logistics: meetup at lobby by the ferns at 12:25 for a 5-min warmup and quick safety note. If rain, we default to staircase repeats inside (same time).
Marco: Showers? I have a 1:15 call and cant be soggy.
Facilities-bot: Showers available in locker room 3. Towels in the cabinet labeled "Wellness". Please leave clean.
Leah: Final count (from reactions): sprint 2 (Marco, Hana), walk 1 (Leah), cheer/official 1 (Sam). Looks small and fun.
Hana: Cool. Ill bring a tiny bell and the protein cookies. Reminder: no reckless vaulting, watch your footing by the cones.
Sam: On my way. Will hold camera duty and moral support. May the crunchiest cookie win. :cookie:
Marco: May the fastest (and least crumbly) win. See you in 20!"
